decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a mix of powerful Elemental creatures, removal spells, and cards that provide card advantage. The main strategy is to establish a board presence of Elementals like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef, while disrupting opponents with Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude. The deck also includes versatile cards like Prismatic Ending and Wrenn and Six to handle a variety of threats, backed up with powerful support from Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a longer game.

The deck revolves around cycling powerful creatures like Architects of Will and Street Wraith to fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a huge swing in tempo. With cards like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's strategy, as well as the cascade mechanic of Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to quickly find and cast Living End, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Elementals and control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating incremental value through card advantage and resource management. It aims to control the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, while also ramping up with Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for a more grindy playstyle and the ability to consistently generate value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can establish a winning board state.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble equipment pieces such as Colossus Hammer and Nettlecyst onto creatures like Memnite and Puresteel Paladin to create a powerful and aggressive board presence. This deck synergizes well with cards like Esper Sentinel and Stoneforge Mystic to draw cards and further develop the combo. Additionally, cards like Spell Pierce provide protection for the combo pieces, while cards like Urza's Saga help to tutor for key artifacts. Overall, the deck aims to win with a quick and explosive combo finish.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and Primeval Titan to search for lands such as Boros Garrison and Gruul Turf to set up a strong board state. The deck aims to ramp quickly into its key cards using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Azusa, Lost but Seeking while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Relic of Progenitus. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Cultivator Colossus while also utilizing lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle for additional damage.

The deck focuses on using the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and untap lands, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion. Karn, the Great Creator acts as both a threat and a way to shut down opponent's artifacts. The deck utilizes a mix of lands to generate multiple colors of mana and has a toolbox sideboard with Urza's Saga as a versatile and powerful land. Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove provide additional ramp and fixing to ensure consistent and explosive combos.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to utilize efficient creatures and spells to quickly close out the game. By combining aggressive threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent with powerful card selection tools like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, this deck aims to maintain a steady stream of pressure while disrupting the opponent with countermagic and removal spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The mana base is designed to support this game plan by providing consistent access to both blue and red mana sources.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer with Puresteel Paladin to equip it for free and deal a massive amount of damage in a single turn. The deck also includes various equipment cards to support this strategy, along with utility creatures like Esper Sentinel and Stoneforge Mystic. The mana base is optimized to support the combo while also providing access to different colors of mana if needed. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a lethal attack.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards that can sacrifice artifacts to generate value, while also synergizing with the ability to bring back key pieces from the graveyard. By combining Academy Manufactor, Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and The Underworld Cookbook, the deck can create a loop of sacrificing and recurring artifacts to achieve a steady advantage. Additionally, cards like Ovalchase Daredevil and Unearth provide additional ways to bring back important creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggro strategy while maintaining a constant stream of resources.

This deck focuses on controlling the board using a combination of powerful Elemental creatures and spells such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like Risen Reef and Wrenn and Six, while providing flexibility with access to a wide range of colors and versatile sideboard options. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and synergy with the deck's ETB effects. The overall strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with a combination of control, card advantage, and powerful Elemental threats.

The main focus of the deck is to combine efficient artifact creatures with powerful artifacts to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. Utilizing cards like Esper Sentinel, Memnite, and Thought Monitor along with support from Urza, Lord High Artificer, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly. The inclusion of cards like Portable Hole, Metallic Rebuke, and Urza's Saga allows for disruption and additional synergy within the deck. Overall, this deck seeks to establish a board presence early on and maintain pressure through a combination of creatures and artifacts.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive Human creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Meddling Mage. Aether Vial allows for creatures to be put into play quickly, while cards like Reflector Mage can bounce back opponent's creatures. The deck aims to build a wide board presence and buff up creatures with Thalia's Lieutenant and Champion of the Parish. The mana base is designed to support the Human tribal theme with lands like Cavern of Souls and Unclaimed Territory.

This deck focuses on casting cheap spells to generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. By using cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cast powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls for free. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counterspells and versatile removal spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with quick aggressive plays while maintaining control of the game through efficient spellcasting and card advantage.

This deck focuses on controlling the game using a combination of powerful Elemental creatures and disruptive spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to generate value from its creatures like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six to recur lands and control the board. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and card advantage. Overall, the deck seeks to establish board control and out-value the opponent through a combination of Elemental synergy and control elements.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, backed up by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It also includes disruptive spells such as Counterspell and Archmage's Charm to control the game and protect your threats. The deck utilizes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. With a focus on tempo and aggression, this deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressive Eldrazi creatures while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with powerful planeswalkers and disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void. By ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and the Urza lands, this deck aims to quickly deploy its threats and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for additional disruption and flexibility in finding key artifacts like Chalice of the Void or Relic of Progenitus. Overall, this deck focuses on applying pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy.
